questions: What is resilience?
If resilience is high, does it always bounce back exactly as before?
What is a threshold?
Once the threshold is crossed, can you simply step back?
What is migration?
When migration ends, does it always reverse?
What is recovery?
After recovery, is everything back to normal?
What is vulnerability?
If the vulnerability is fixed, is the danger over?
What is a hazard?
Once the hazard has passed, is the danger over?
What is a cascade?
When a cascade reaches the bottom, is it finished?
What is stress?
When the stress is gone, does the system spring back to where it was?
What is retreat?
After a retreat, do you go back once it is safe?
What are loss and damage?
If loss and damage are paid for, are they gone?
What is exposure?
If the exposure is brief, is it harmless?
What is sensitivity?
If sensitivity is high, is that always a good thing?
What is capacity?
If the capacity runs out, can it be restored quickly?
What is a carbon budget?
Once the carbon budget is spent, can you just start a new one?
What is a return period?
If the return period is long, will the event wait that long before happening again?
